conditions.notes: Presented with bloody nasal discharge, orbital pseudotumor, and pulmonary nodules. Nasal biopsy confirmed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with vasculitis. PR3-ANCA positive. BVAS at diagnosis was 8.

During first rituximab infusion, patient developed severe infusion reaction (Grade 3): rigors, hypotension, bronchospasm requiring epinephrine. Infusion terminated. Rituximab permanently contraindicated. This qualifies as failure/intolerance to standard therapy.

social_history.exercise: Runs 3x/week when feeling well, currently reduced to walking
social_history.occupation: PhD candidate in Environmental Engineering at UC Berkeley
